 See what the stars have in store for your sign By Snehaa Khanna Sahgal 7 November 2026 Illustration by: Saahir Shetty ( @saahir_shetty ) Move on from your survival mode, Taurus . Your instincts are teaching you something—your attention is being drawn in a particular direction. And all your guides suggest that you pay close attention. You have two paths in front of you. And you somehow know where you want to be headed. Your intuition is connected very deeply with your wisdom, Leo . At this point in time, your freedom-loving side, that part of you that hates being chained down or bound down in any way, is connecting you to Source or the cosmos, helping you establish a direct hotline with your long-term goals, your peace of mind and your inner wealth. Stay anchored in your truth—that reason you got started? Keep that at the forefront of your mind, Cancer . Take one step at a time with your long-term vision in focus and let the rest float by as it comes. The maddening rush of the world is not for you—sure, it may seem exciting for a bit, but then you must remember to come back to yourself.
 Read on for what the stars have in store for you and make sure you check out your sun, moon and rising signs for the complete picture.
 Aries Horoscope Today: November 7, 2026 
 Illustration by: Saahir Shetty ( @saahir_shetty ) You set off on an adventure with complete faith in your heart. Aries , now that the wheel feels like it's slowing down, what is needed is a bit of space and deep reflection. Figure out multiple alternative ways to approach the same situation. Notice loopholes you may not be able to perceive as yet, and then ask the cosmos to grant you a crack to slip through. You are banking on your prayers,s and the cosmos says they will be granted if you hold the vision and stay anchored in your energy.
 Cosmic tip: Wish upon a star.
 Taurus Horoscope Today: November 7, 2026 
 Illustration by: Saahir Shetty ( @saahir_shetty ) Move on from your survival mode, Taurus . Your instincts are teaching you something—your attention is being drawn in a particular direction. And all your guides suggest that you pay close attention. You have two paths in front of you. And you somehow know where you want to be headed. Pick the road that is opening up in front of you. Does it feel a bit scary? Yes. But is it also equally exciting? Yes. See through your situation and move forward.
 Cosmic tip: Take a break and rest.
 Gemini Horoscope Today: November 7, 2026 
 Illustration by: Saahir Shetty ( @saahir_shetty ) Instead of carrying forward someone else’s expectations of you and playing them out as your own, Gemini , pause. Come back to yourself and ask yourself where your inner voice has been guiding you, and why have you stopped listening to it? You have been taking small,l tiny steps along the way. You have been sitting in a better place than before. Yet you feel like you are in a constant rush. Yet you feel incomplete and empty-ish. Why? Because you are running in a million directions. If you have forgotten what led you to this point, and why, it is a good time to revisit that once again.
 Cosmic tip: Recall your energy back onto you.
 Cancer Horoscope Today: November 7, 2026 
 Illustration by: Saahir Shetty ( @saahir_shetty ) You are on the verge of blending your spirituality with practicality, Cancer . Be it within your relationships or within your work life. There are ideas you keep circling back to. Time and again. And honestly, it may simply be time for you to pick up the pace and get going with things. Stay anchored in your truth. That reason you got started? Keep that at the forefront of your mind. Take one step at a time with your long-term vision in focus and let the rest float by as it comes. The maddening rush of the world is not for you. Sure, it may seem exciting for a bit, but then you must remember to come back to yourself.
 Cosmic tip: Your innocent perspective is your strength. Play on it wisely.
 Leo Horoscope Today: November 7, 2026 
 Illustration by: Saahir Shetty ( @saahir_shetty ) Your intuition is connected very deeply with your wisdom, Leo . At this point in time, your freedom-loving side, that part of you that hates being chained down or bound down in any way, is connecting you to Source or the cosmos, helping you establish a direct hotline with your long-term goals, your peace of mind and your inner wealth. This may be your time to draw up firm boundaries and assert your needs and desires clearly, be it around your relationships, ideas or finances. There is no wrong way of doing this, just the one that feels right to you. Stand your ground.
 Cosmic tip: Take off your blindfold and decide your path ahead.
 Virgo Horoscope Today: November 7, 2026 
 Illustration by: Saahir Shetty ( @saahir_shetty ) There may be a particular workplace or personal life situation where you may feel like someone may be telling on you, judging you, taunting you or simply pushing you to the wall, holding you back, and you may have had no choice but to distance yourself, push back or simply figure out alternative ways to get things going. The point is, Virgo , you tried your best to keep your peace and maintain your space. And if someone or something may have been acting suspiciously, trust your gut and wait your turn. The cosmos is watching and guarding you.
 Cosmic tip: The dawn is breaking out from the night sky.
 Libra Horoscope Today: November 7, 2026 
 Illustration by: Saahir Shetty ( @saahir_shetty ) Things are clear, Libra . Have they been smooth? Not exactly. But have solutions and a sense of relief found you? Yes, of course. You did your best to make things work, and your efforts have reaped massive rewards. Things have been brought to light, and even though conflicting information, motives or ideals may have surfaced, you and the entire situation are better for it.
 Cosmic tip: Better days are here. Look forward to celebrating.
 Scorpio Horoscope Today: November 7, 2026 
 Illustration by: Saahir Shetty ( @saahir_shetty ) You may have taken on something with great passion and gusto, but soon you may have found that it may have got you feeling trapped and stuck, even chained in some strange way. Scorpio , you have it in you to stop the chase. You have it in you to move beyond this. Take a deep breath and imagine your life flowing with much greater ease; your intangible goals meeting you sooner than you expect; that feeling of peace, ease, comfort and happiness really coming forward in many ways, in a swifter manner. Then ask yourself how else you can create this for yourself, in ways that you have not experienced yet? Follow your instincts.
 Cosmic tip: Make your intuition guide your actions to optimise your efforts and rewards.
 Sagittarius Horoscope Today: November 7, 2026 
 Illustration by: Saahir Shetty ( @saahir_shetty ) Freedom is a theme you have been chasing, and it honestly is not a chase; it is your blueprint. Sag , you love a good celebration; you love a sense of community and belonging, but have you been confusing it for validation? As long as you have this bit in check, you are good. It is only when you get too dependent on perceived timelines, values and perceptions and internalise it as your sense of inner worthiness, that’s when you fall into the trap of constantly seeking stimulation and meaningless social commitments. Filter this through: build a large community if you must, but keep following your purpose.
 Cosmic tip: Celebrate life itself, for what it blesses you with.
 Capricorn Horoscope Today: November 7, 2026 
 Illustration by: Saahir Shetty ( @saahir_shetty ) Weigh your options before you decide to go play with fire, Capricorn . There are several ways to go about a situation just as there are several ways to say the same thing. “I do not wish to fail”; “I want to succeed” or “I can’t wait to see how successful this makes me feel” are three ways to say the same thing. But while you are focusing on the best possible words or route ahead, you must also stay aware of the loopholes, blind spots and probable re-routes that may need to be taken along the way; a new beginning calls for a child-like curious mindset.
 Cosmic tip: Contentment and real happiness are the main pillars of life.
 Aquarius Horoscope Today: November 7, 2026 
 Illustration by: Saahir Shetty ( @saahir_shetty ) Perhaps the reason things may have felt slower and more resistant than usual is that you may have gone into a defensive overdrive. Aquarius , yes, protecting your peace and space is important at times, but over time it can also become a habit that you find challenging to get out of. Your guides remind you to touch base with your inner ideals, needs and self. What makes you tick and what makes you want to show up. Now find that reason and figure out how you can practically put it to work. It is only your fear of failure that is holding you back, not a lack of skills.
 Cosmic tip: Get rolling with your ideas.
 Pisces Horoscope Today: November 7, 2026 
 Illustration by: Saahir Shetty ( @saahir_shetty ) You are free. You are not waiting, and you definitely are not holding yourself back in the name of some long-term gain and game. Pisces , initially what may have felt like a mistakenly delivered package from the cosmos, may slowly grow on you, and you may realise that life is actually taking shape in unimagined but better ways. The world is not waiting, and neither are you. You are concluding that you can carry on at your own pace while others’ worlds continue to spin around at theirs.
 Cosmic tip: Detangle yourself from the unseen mental chains you have been carrying.
